svg.text: 1 : N seats belong to a screen

Multiplicity is shown at each end of an association. Enumerations are declared on the right; every enum lives in com.cinebook.model.enums. Receipt and BookingSummary projections are omitted for clarity.
ConcessionLine is the immutable line Booking holds: BookingDao maps each booking_concession row into one, snapshotted at sale time.
